families.label: Business Management Functions V1
notes: Official Functions V1 docs manage the fundamental function objects in the Wix Functions ecosystem.
Wix says creating a function directly leaves logic and configuration to separate APIs; Function Production or Builderless Production can create a function with dependencies in a single call.
Writes are plan-first. Update requires function.revision. Delete and filtered bulk tag updates require --ack-irreversible because delete is permanent and an empty filter can update all functions.

families.label: Business Management Functions Function Types
notes: Official Function Types docs expose read-only methods for retrieving function type definitions available on the site.
Wix says function types are provided by installed business solutions and define where custom logic can run.
Query Function Types defaults to paging.limit 50 and paging.offset 0 and does not support filters or sorting.

families.label: Business Management Functions Function Templates
notes: Official Function Templates docs expose read-only methods for retrieving function templates available for a site.
Templates are drafts that can be used for basic function creation or builderless function creation; builderless creation requires templates with formTemplateExtensionId.

Query Function Templates requires appDefId and functionExtensionId filters, defaults to paging.limit 50 and paging.offset 0, and supports documented filters and sorting for appDefId and functionExtensionId.

families.label: Business Management Functions Function Productions
notes: Official Function Productions docs expose create, update, and delete methods for creating functions with their automation, service plugin configuration, and function method dependencies in one call.
Create Function Production can create from a function type or function template; templates with formTemplateExtensionId must use the Builderless Productions API instead.
Delete Function Production deletes the production and all associated entities, so the CLI treats it as irreversible.

families.label: Business Management Functions Builderless Productions
notes: Official Builderless Productions docs expose create, get, and update methods for creating functions from templates that include formTemplateExtensionId.
Create Function Builderless Production creates a ready-to-activate function plus automation, service plugin configuration, and function method dependencies.
After elements are updated through other APIs, Update Function Builderless Production may no longer affect the out-of-date builderless production object.

families.label: Business Management Functions Function Methods
notes: Official Function Methods docs expose create, delete, and query methods for links between functions and automations.
Wix says creating a function method directly is not recommended; use Function Productions or Builderless Productions for full function creation.
Query Function Methods defaults to createdDate DESC, paging.limit 50, and paging.offset 0. Supported filters and sorting include id, functionId, and automationId.
Function Method Created and Function Method Deleted are webhook/event surfaces rather than CLI commands.

families.label: Business Management Functions Function Activations
notes: Official Function Activations docs expose upsert and delete methods for making functions live or inactive.
Upsert Function Activation activates a draft function or reactivates an already active function so its latest changes go live.
Delete Function Activation deactivates the function whose ID is specified and sets activation status to INACTIVE.
Both commands are guarded because they change whether business solutions can execute the function.

families.label: Business Management Functions Function SPI Configurations
notes: Official Function SPI Configurations docs expose create, get, update, delete, query, and validate methods for service plugin configuration data used by functions.
A function can have at most one service plugin configuration.

Update requires the current functionSpiConfiguration.revision and does not immediately affect active functions; callers must reactivate the function with Function Activations to publish the latest configuration.
Query defaults to createdDate DESC, paging.limit 50, and paging.offset 0. Supported filters and sorting include id and functionId.
Validate checks a configuration against the service plugin schema without creating it.
SPI Configuration Created, Deleted, and Updated are webhook/event surfaces rather than CLI commands.

families.label: CRM Tasks
families.coverage_notes: Official CRM Tasks methods are shipped as explicit crm-tasks commands. Get, query, and count are reads/helpers. Create, update, and move-after are reviewed-plan writes. Delete is a reviewed-plan write that also requires --ack-irreversible because it removes a task. Official docs say query defaults to createdDate DESC, count can accept an optional filter, update requires the existing task revision, move-after reorders task display and can place a task first when beforeTaskId is omitted, and Task Created, Task Deleted, Task Overdue, and Task Updated are callback-only events.

families.label: CRM Pipelines Management - Pipelines
families.coverage_notes: Official CRM Pipelines methods are shipped as explicit crm-pipelines commands. Get and query are reads. Create, update, and bulk-update-tags are reviewed-plan writes. Delete and bulk-update-tags-by-filter require --ack-irreversible because delete permanently removes a pipeline and the filtered tag update can affect all pipelines when no filter is supplied. All callable method pages are marked Developer Preview in official Wix docs. Official docs say pipelines must have at least one regular stage plus a doneStage, doneStage needs at least one allowed outcome, currency cannot be changed once set, update requires the current pipeline revision, pipelines or stages that contain cards cannot be deleted, and bulk-update-tags-by-filter returns an async job ID. Pipeline Created, Pipeline Deleted, and Pipeline Updated are callback-only events.

families.label: CRM Pipelines Management - Cards
families.coverage_notes: Official CRM Cards methods are shipped as explicit crm-cards commands. Get, query, search, and search-by-stage are reads. Create, update, bulk-update-tags, and move are reviewed-plan writes. Delete and bulk-update-tags-by-filter require --ack-irreversible because delete permanently removes a card and the filtered tag update can affect every card in a pipeline when no filter is supplied. All callable method pages are marked Developer Preview in official Wix docs. Official docs say cards must belong to an existing pipeline and stage, can only move between stages in the same pipeline, update requires the current card revision and cannot change pipelineId or currency, moving to the final stage needs a valid doneStage outcome, and bulk-update-tags-by-filter returns an async job ID. Card Assigned, Card Created, Card Deleted, Card Moved, Card Overdue, Card Stale, and Card Updated are callback-only events.

families.label: Multilingual Locale Management Locale Settings
notes: Official docs say the Wix Multilingual app must be installed.
Set Multilingual Mode enables or disables multilingual support.

Update Locale Settings cannot update multilingual mode; use set-mode for that field.

families.label: Multilingual Locale Management Locales
notes: Official docs say multilingual mode must be enabled before creating secondary locales.
A site can have up to 200 locales and up to 100 visible locales.
Deleting locales permanently removes the locale and associated translated data, so delete commands require --ack-irreversible.
Create New Primary Locale starts a site-wide primary locale change and returns a token; check status with get-new-primary-status.

families.label: Multilingual Translation Schema
notes: Official docs say the Wix Multilingual app must be installed.
Schemas define app translatable entity structure and fields for future translation content.
Update Schema requires the current schema revision.
Removing a schema field makes the corresponding content field unavailable, so field-removal updates require --ack-irreversible.
Delete Schema is an irreversible reviewed-plan write and requires --ack-irreversible.

families.label: Multilingual Translation Content
notes: Official docs say the Wix Multilingual app must be installed.
Content is validated against the corresponding translation schema.
Create and bulk create require schemaId, entityId, locale, and fields.
Update by ID requires content.id and content.schemaId; key-based updates require schemaId, entityId, and locale.
Deletes and bulk deletes require --ack-irreversible. Updates that remove fields require --ack-irreversible because Wix says an empty field object removes that field.
Content Created, Content Deleted, and Content Updated are callback-only events, not CLI commands.

families.label: Multilingual Translation Published Content
notes: Official docs say this API only queries translated content that has been marked as ready to publish.
Query Published Content returns up to 100 items and defaults to id ASC.
The query filter must include schemaKey.appId, schemaKey.entityType, and schemaKey.scope.
Published Content Created, Deleted, and Updated are callback-only events, not CLI commands.

families.label: Multilingual Machine Translation
notes: Official docs say the Wix Multilingual app must be installed.
Machine Translate translates one translatable content unit; Bulk Machine Translate translates up to 1,000 units.
Wix does not overwrite original content; callers must store translated content separately.
Only text content is translated; collapsible text is unsupported.
Each content unit must not exceed 5,000 characters, with rich-content limits applied per node.
Successful translation consumes site word credits, so live apply requires --ack-irreversible.

families.label: Multilingual Machine Translation Credit Data
notes: Official docs say the Wix Multilingual app must be installed.
Get Credit Data returns the site's word credit usage and quota data.
Check Sufficient Credits checks whether a site has enough credits for a requested word count and does not spend credits.

The generated curl example for Check Sufficient Credits currently says GET, but the rendered REST page and embedded schema say POST with required JSON body wordCount; this CLI follows the rendered REST page and schema.

families.label: Online Programs Programs
notes: Official docs say the Wix Online Programs app must be installed.
Create Program creates a draft program; Publish Program publishes a draft program.
Update Program and Bulk Update Programs require current revisions.
Bulk Update Programs accepts 1-100 items.
Delete Program permanently removes the program, cancels its scheduled end task, removes related member groups, and removes it from search.
Archive Program closes the program, removes it from normal public discovery, and replaces its SEO slug with the program ID.
End Program changes a published program to ENDED and cancels any scheduled end task.

families.label: Online Programs Instructor V2

Update Instructor requires instructor.id.
Assign and Unassign require programId.
Change Program Instructors requires programId and accepts up to 10 assignInstructorIds plus up to 10 unassignInstructorIds.
Invite Instructor sends an email invitation.

families.coverage_notes: Official Community Groups core callable methods are shipped as explicit community-groups commands. families.label: Community Group Rules
families.coverage_notes: Official Community Group Rules methods are shipped as explicit community-group-rules commands. List is a read. Create or replace all rules is a reviewed-plan replacement write and requires --ack-irreversible because existing rules are replaced. Group Rules Updated is callback-only.

families.label: Community Create Group Requests
families.coverage_notes: Official Community Create Group Requests methods are shipped as explicit community-group-requests commands. List and query are reads. Approve and reject are reviewed-plan writes and require --ack-irreversible because they decide site-member requests to create groups. Group Request Approved and Group Request Rejected are callback-only.

families.label: Community Group Members
families.coverage_notes: Official Community Group Members methods are shipped as explicit community-group-members commands. List, list memberships, query, and query memberships are reads. Add and remove are reviewed-plan writes and require --ack-irreversible because they change group membership and can invite or remove site members. Member Added and Member Removed are callback-only.

families.label: Community Group Roles
families.coverage_notes: Official Community Group Roles methods are shipped as explicit community-group-roles commands. Assign and unassign are reviewed-plan writes and require --ack-irreversible because they change group permissions. Official docs say assigning overrides current role.value, unassigning only supports ADMIN roles, and only group admins can call these methods. Role Assigned To Group Member and Role Unassigned From Group Member are callback-only.

families.label: Community Join Group Requests
families.coverage_notes: Official Community Join Group Requests methods are shipped as explicit community-join-requests commands. List and query read join requests for one private group. Approve and reject are reviewed-plan writes and require --ack-irreversible because they decide whether pending site members join a private group. Join Group Request Approved and Join Group Request Rejected are callback-only.

families.label: Community Membership Questions
families.coverage_notes: Official Community Membership Questions methods are shipped as explicit community-membership-questions commands. List reads questions for one group. List answers reads submitted answers by explicit official memberIds and paging inputs. Create or replace is a reviewed-plan write and requires --ack-irreversible because it replaces all existing questions; --questions-json must be Wix's official object with a questions array, and an empty questions array means members will not have to answer any question when joining.

families.label: Community Comments
families.coverage_notes: Official Feedback and Moderation Comments methods are shipped as explicit community-comments commands. Get, query, count, list by resource, and get thread are reads/helpers. Create and update are reviewed-plan writes. Delete, mark, unmark, hide, publish, draft moderation, and all bulk moderation actions require --ack-irreversible because they change public moderation state, move comments, or delete comment content.

families.label: Community Reviews
families.coverage_notes: Official Feedback and Moderation Reviews methods are shipped as explicit community-reviews commands. Official docs say Reviews is currently only available with the stores namespace. Get, query, and count are reads/helpers. Create, update, and set reply are reviewed-plan writes. Delete, remove reply, moderation-status changes, and bulk actions require --ack-irreversible because they delete review content or replies, change moderation/publication state, or affect multiple reviews.

families.label: Community Review Requests
families.coverage_notes: Official Feedback and Moderation Review Requests methods are shipped as explicit community-review-requests commands. Official docs say Review Requests is currently only available with the stores namespace. Get, query, and count are reads/helpers. Create is a reviewed-plan write. Delete and bulk cancel by filter require --ack-irreversible because delete removes canceled requests and bulk cancel starts an async job that can cancel multiple review requests.

families.label: Community Moderation Rules
families.coverage_notes: Official Feedback and Moderation Moderation Rules methods are shipped as explicit community-moderation-rules commands. Get, query, and check content are reads/helpers. Create, update, and delete require --ack-irreversible because moderation rules automate content moderation and can change how newly submitted comments or reviews are approved, rejected, or sent for manual approval.

families.label: Community Reports V2
families.coverage_notes: Official Feedback and Moderation Reports V2 methods are shipped as explicit community-reports commands. Official docs say Reports V2 is currently supported for Wix Comments only. Get, query, and count by reason types are reads/helpers. Create, update, and upsert are reviewed-plan writes. Delete and bulk delete by filter require --ack-irreversible because they remove reports from the dashboard report list; bulk delete can remove multiple reports.

families.label: Communication Inbox Conversations
families.coverage_notes: Official Inbox Conversations methods are shipped as explicit inbox-conversations commands. Get is a read. Get or create is a reviewed-plan write because it can create a conversation for the participant. Conversations Merged is callback-only.

families.label: Communication Inbox Messages
families.coverage_notes: Official Inbox Messages methods are shipped as explicit inbox-messages commands. List is a read. Send is a reviewed-plan write and requires --ack-irreversible because it sends a message to the business or participant and can send notifications. Button Interacted, Message Sent To Business, and Message Sent To Participant are callback-only.

families.label: Loyalty Program Management Program
families.coverage_notes: Official Loyalty Program Management Program methods are shipped as explicit loyalty-program commands. Get and premium features are reads. Update, activate, pause, enable points expiration, and disable points expiration are reviewed-plan writes and require --ack-irreversible because they change program-wide loyalty settings, status, or points-expiration behavior. Loyalty Program Updated is callback-only.

families.label: Loyalty Program Management Earning Rules
families.coverage_notes: Official Loyalty Program Management Earning Rules methods are shipped as explicit loyalty-earning-rules commands. List and get are reads. Create, update, delete, bulk create, create custom, and delete automation are reviewed-plan writes and require --ack-irreversible because earning rules change how customers earn loyalty points. The official method endpoint headers and fetch examples use the /_api/loyalty-earning-rules root, while some curl examples omit /_api; this inventory follows the endpoint headers and fetch examples. Earning Rule Created, Updated, and Deleted are callback-only.

families.label: Loyalty Program Management Tiers
families.coverage_notes: Official Loyalty Program Management Tiers methods are shipped as explicit loyalty-tiers commands. List, get, and get program settings are reads. Create, update, delete, bulk create, get program, create program settings, and update program settings are reviewed-plan writes and require --ack-irreversible because they change tier definitions, thresholds, or global tier program settings. Official docs say get program creates default settings if none exist, creating tiers requires a Plus or Business plan, bulk create can create up to 20 tiers, delete requires the current revision query value, and program-settings update must include status, revision, and rollingWindow. Tier Created, Updated, and Deleted are callback-only.

families.label: Loyalty Program Accounts
families.coverage_notes: Official Loyalty Accounts methods are shipped as explicit loyalty-accounts commands. List is deprecated by Wix and exposed only as a compatibility read; get, query, search, count, program totals, current-member account, and secondary-ID lookup are reads/helpers. Create, adjust points, bulk adjust points, and earn points are reviewed-plan writes and require --ack-irreversible because they create customer loyalty accounts or change point balances. Official docs say accounts require an active loyalty program, create requires contactId, adjust points requires a current revision in this CLI, bulk adjust returns an async job ID, and earn points requires a positive amount, appId, and idempotencyKey. Loyalty Account Created, Points Updated, Account Reward Availability Updated, and Loyalty Account Updated are callback-only.

families.label: Loyalty Program Accounts Transactions
families.coverage_notes: Official Loyalty Transactions methods are shipped as explicit loyalty-transactions commands. Get and query are read-only and require Read Loyalty. Official docs say transactions cover account activity such as earn, redeem, adjust, refund, expire, and earn-attempt records.

families.label: Loyalty Program Accounts Social Media
families.coverage_notes: Official Loyalty Social Media methods are shipped as explicit loyalty-social-media commands. List is a read requiring visitor or member authentication and Read Loyalty. Create is a reviewed-plan write requiring visitor or member authentication, Manage Loyalty, and --ack-irreversible because it records a followed social media channel and can award loyalty points. Official docs say members can only follow channels enabled in the dashboard. Followed Channel Created is callback-only.

families.label: Loyalty Program Accounts Imports
families.coverage_notes: Official Loyalty Imports methods are shipped as explicit loyalty-imports commands. Get, query, and get-error-file-download-url are reads/helpers. Create-file-url is a reviewed-plan helper write because it creates the official upload URL and file path for the import flow. Create and execute are reviewed-plan writes requiring --ack-irreversible because loyalty imports can overwrite existing customer point balances. Official docs say the source file must be CSV, requires customer email and points balance columns, can continue despite row-level errors, and has a 10MB max file size. Loyalty Import Created is callback-only.

families.label: Loyalty Program Rewards
families.coverage_notes: Official Loyalty Rewards methods for reward definitions are shipped as explicit loyalty-rewards commands. List, get, and query are reads/helpers. Create, bulk create, update, and delete are reviewed-plan writes and require --ack-irreversible because they change customer-redeemable reward definitions. Official docs say list includes currently nonredeemable rewards, query defaults cursorPaging.limit to 50, reward active defaults to false, reward type cannot be changed after creation, tier-specific costs and discounts use configsByTier, and Reward Created, Reward Deleted, and Reward Updated are callback-only. Loyalty Checkout Discount and Loyalty Coupons are separate Rewards subfamilies and remain tracked in docs/api_coverage.md.

families.label: Loyalty Program Rewards Checkout Discount
families.coverage_notes: Official Loyalty Checkout Discount methods are shipped as explicit loyalty-checkout-discounts commands. Query is a read/helper and defaults to paging.limit 50 plus createdDate DESC sort when omitted. Apply Discount To Checkout is a reviewed-plan write and requires --ack-irreversible because it can redeem loyalty points or apply a customer reward, loyalty coupon, or referral reward to an eCommerce checkout. Official docs say the site must have Wix Loyalty Program installed and must also have Wix Bookings, Wix Stores, or Wix Restaurants Orders (New).

families.label: Loyalty Program Rewards Coupons
families.coverage_notes: Official Loyalty Coupons methods are shipped as explicit loyalty-coupons commands. Get, query, and get-current-member are reads/helpers. Redeem current member points, redeem points for a coupon, and delete loyalty coupon are reviewed-plan writes and require --ack-irreversible because they redeem loyalty points or remove a loyalty coupon record. Official docs say a loyalty coupon is created when a customer redeems points, creates a corresponding reference coupon, and deleting the loyalty coupon does not impact the corresponding coupon itself. Coupon Created and Coupon Deleted are callback-only.

families.label: Business Management Get Paid Payment Links
notes: Official Payment Links docs expose create, get, delete, query, search, activate, deactivate, initiate payment, send, set note, update extended fields, bulk tag update, and bulk tag update by filter methods.
Payment links are only available for premium sites with at least one connected payment method.
Once settings including price value and payment limit are set during creation, Wix says they cannot be changed.
Payment links cannot be deleted once funds have been received for them.
Send Payment Link can send to up to 50 specified recipients.
Bulk Update Payment Link Tags By Filter is async and an empty filter updates all payment links, so apply requires --ack-irreversible.
Payment Link Created, Deleted, Activated, Deactivated, Note Set, Payment Initiated, Sent, and Updated are webhook/event surfaces rather than CLI commands.

families.label: Business Management Get Paid Payment Link Payments

Issue Receipt creates a receipt for the specified payment link payment and requires Manage Paylinks.
Payment Link Payment Created and Updated are webhook/event surfaces rather than CLI commands.

families.label: Business Management Get Paid Payment Link Settings
notes: Official Payment Link Settings docs expose get and update methods for site payment link checkout settings.
Get Payment Links Settings requires Manage Paylinks and reads /payment-links/v1/payment-links-settings.
Update Payment Links Settings requires Manage Paylinks and patches /payment-links/v1/payment-links-settings.
The update command is reviewed-plan only; apply requires --plan-in, --apply, and --yes. Verification is by provider response plus rerunning payment-link-settings get.

families.label: Business Management Get Paid Receipts
notes: Official Receipts docs expose create, get, query, get latest receipt number, regenerate document, send receipt email, and update extended fields methods.
Receipts can be created but not deleted, and only one receipt can be created for each transaction.
Get Latest Receipt Number can be filtered by receipt prefix.
Regenerate Receipt Document is intended for failed or stuck documents.
Send Receipt Email notifies the customer and is guarded with --ack-irreversible.
Update Extended Fields updates custom fields only and does not increment revision.
Receipt Created, Sent, and Updated are webhook/event surfaces rather than CLI commands.

families.label: Business Management Get Paid Receipt Presets
notes: Official Receipt Presets docs expose create, get, update, delete, list, get default, set default, and update extended fields methods.
Receipt presets define configurable receipt information, design, branding, and custom details, but receipt layouts must be managed from the Wix dashboard.
Update Receipt Preset requires the current receiptPreset.revision.
Delete Receipt Preset permanently deletes a preset and can return a failed precondition.
Set Default Receipt Preset changes the preset used when receipt creation does not specify an existing preset.
Update Extended Fields updates custom fields only and does not increment revision.
Receipt Preset Created, Deleted, and Updated are webhook/event surfaces rather than CLI commands.

families.label: Business Management Get Paid Receipts Settings
notes: Official Receipts Settings docs expose get and update methods for site-level receipt numbering settings.
Only one receipts settings entity exists per site.
A site's receipts settings cannot be deleted.
Update Receipts Settings updates a site's receipt settings, or creates them if none exist.
Update Receipts Settings requires the current receiptsSettings.revision to prevent conflicting changes.
Receipts Settings Updated is a webhook/event surface rather than a CLI command.

families.label: Business Management Headless OAuth Apps
notes: Official Headless OAuth Apps docs expose create, get, update, and query methods under /oauth-app/v1/oauth-apps.
OAuth apps authorize external client apps or sites to authenticate with a Wix Headless project or site and manage its data.
Create OAuth App enables an external client to access a Wix project or site.
Update OAuth App updates only fields provided in mask.paths.
Query OAuth Apps supports filtering by id and sorting by createdDate or name.
OAuth App Created, Deleted, and Updated are webhook/event surfaces rather than CLI commands.

families.label: Business Management Headless Authentication
notes: Official Headless Authentication docs expose Retrieve Tokens, Change Password, Login V2, Logout, Register V2, and Sign On.
Login V2 and Register V2 return sessionToken values that can be exchanged for access and refresh tokens.
Retrieve Tokens accepts JSON or form-encoded requests in the official docs; this CLI exposes the JSON form only and redacts access_token and refresh_token in output.
Change Password, Logout, and Sign On are marked Developer Preview in the current rendered official docs. Retrieve Tokens is also marked Developer Preview.
Register V2 may create a member or trigger contact-email verification. Sign On may create or update a member account and is only for trusted integrations with verified user information.
All password, code, cookie, sessionToken, access token, and refresh token fields are redacted from emitted request/response data, plans, receipts, and audit payloads.

families.label: Business Management Headless Recovery
notes: Official Headless Recovery docs expose Send Recovery Email as the only callable method in this family.
Send Recovery Email sends a member an email with a unique link to a Wix-managed password reset page.
Official docs say the connected Wix site must be published because Wix uses the published site to display the reset page.
Official docs say any redirect URL used after password change must be added as an allowed authorization redirect URI.
The sample flow recommends checking that the member exists before sending the recovery email.
Provider response can prove Wix accepted the request, but cannot prove inbox delivery or password reset completion.

families.label: Business Management Headless Redirects
notes: Official Headless Redirects docs expose Create Redirect Session as the only callable method in this family.

Create Redirect Session creates a single-use URL for redirecting a visitor from an external Headless client site to a Wix-managed page for authentication, logout, bookings checkout, eCommerce checkout, events checkout, paid plans checkout, product page, or bookings book page flows.
Official docs say allowed redirect domains and allowed authorization redirect URIs must be configured in Headless Settings before use.
Official docs say the connected Wix site must be published because Wix uses the published site to display Wix-managed pages.

The current official docs disagree on the endpoint path: the rendered method page shows /_api/redirects-api/v1/redirect-session, the generated REST schema shows /headless/v1/redirect-session, and the official REST guide plus method curl example show /redirect-session/v1/redirect-session. This CLI follows the rendered method page path.
Redirect Session Created is a webhook/event surface rather than a CLI command.

families.label: Business Management Headless Sitemap
notes: Official Headless Sitemap docs expose List Sitemap Pages as the only callable method in this family.
List Sitemap Pages lists sitemap entries for a supported item type with optional cursor pagination.

Supported item types in the current official schema are STORES_PRODUCT, BLOG_POST, BLOG_CATEGORY, BLOG_TAGS, BLOG_ARCHIVE, FORUM_POST, FORUM_CATEGORY, GROUPS_POST, GROUPS_PAGE, EVENTS_PAGE, BOOKINGS_SERVICE, MEMBERS_AREA_PROFILE, CHALLENGES_PAGE, STORES_CATEGORY, STORES_SUB_CATEGORY, PORTFOLIO_COLLECTIONS, PORTFOLIO_PROJECTS, PRICING_PLANS, and RESTAURANTS_MENU_PAGE.

The current official docs disagree on the endpoint path: the rendered method page and embedded schema show /v1/list-sitemap-pages, while the official curl example shows /seo/v1/headless-sitemap/pages. This CLI follows the rendered method page and embedded schema path.
This family is read-only and has no callback event page in the current official menu.

families.label: Business Management Headless Verification
notes: Official Headless Verification docs expose Verify During Authentication as the only callable method in this family.
Verify During Authentication continues a registration flow when Wix requires email verification using a code received by email and a stateToken from the REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION state.
The method is marked Developer Preview in the current official rendered docs.

The current official docs disagree on the endpoint path: the rendered method page and official curl example show /_api/iam/verification/v1/auth/verify, while the generated markdown schema shows /v1/auth/verify. This CLI follows the rendered method page path.

Provider response can return SUCCESS and a sessionToken, or another auth state. This CLI redacts code, stateToken, sessionToken, access token, and refresh token values and keeps token retrieval as a separate Headless Authentication step.

families.label: Business Management Get Paid Billable Items
notes: Official Billable Items docs expose create, get, update, delete, query, search, bulk create, bulk delete, bulk update, bulk tag update, and bulk tag update by filter methods.
All methods require Wix app or Wix user identity auth and Manage Billable Items.
Create Billable Item, Search Billable Items, and Bulk Update Billable Items are marked Developer Preview in the current rendered docs.
Update requires the current billableItem.revision.
Delete and bulk delete are destructive reviewed-plan writes requiring --ack-irreversible.
Bulk Update Billable Item Tags By Filter is async and an empty filter updates all billable items, so apply requires --ack-irreversible.
Billable Item Created, Deleted, and Updated are webhook/event surfaces rather than CLI commands.
